info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Sub Custodian Agreement Retrieval API
info.description: The Sub Custodian Agreement Retrieval API enables users to access detailed sub custodian agreements held by financial institutions. This API is essential for banking partners, asset managers, and compliance officers seeking to review or audit custodial arrangements. By providing endpoint access to these agreements, it supports transparency and facilitates regulatory compliance. Typical consumers of this API include operational teams within banks and investment firms requiring up-to-date agreement information.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of the sub-custodian agreement associated with the specified external agency. The response includes all pertinent information regarding the agreement, facilitating informed decision-making and compliance management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the sub-custodian agreement details from the external agency. It must conform to the required schema and contain the necessary parameters to successfully retrieve the information.

GetSubCustodianAgreementRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation related to the sub-custodian agreement for external agencies.
